title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds).
